description: Antenas de comunicação is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . Providing geographical information on communication antennas located in the municipality of Águeda. Coverage:  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . The portal shows the English title as "Communication antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . Its keywords include ckan-sig-cm-agueda-pt. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GPKG, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2020-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
